title: Jacob Confers with Rachel and Leah
image_prompt: Quiet open pasture at sunset: weathered patriarch Jacob with graying beard meeting secretly among grazing sheep with his wives Rachel and Leah, gesturing urgently toward the horizon as both women nod in resolute agreement to depart.

title: Secret Flight Across the Euphrates
image_prompt: Vast dawn panorama: Jacob mounting his children and wives onto decorated camels, leading massive flocks of sheep and laden pack animals across the shallow waters of the Euphrates River, heading in haste toward Mount Gilead.

title: Laban Searches the Tents
image_prompt: Interior of a richly woven desert tent: frustrated older uncle Laban searching among travel bags while graceful Rachel sits calmly draped in flowing robes upon a high wicker camel saddle, hiding the household idols beneath her cushions.

title: The Covenant Pillar at Galeed
image_prompt: Rocky hilltop of Gilead under clearing morning skies: Jacob and Laban stacking rough limestone boulders into a large memorial heap, setting an upright stone pillar between them and sharing a solemn meal of peace.

title: Angels at Mahanaim and the Approaching 400
image_prompt: Split dramatic composition: Jacob encountering shimmering celestial angelic sentinels at Mahanaim, contrasted below with anxious scouts reporting back that muscular brother Esau is riding fast toward them with 400 armed desert men.

title: Jacob's Night Prayer at the Jabbok
image_prompt: Eerie midnight scene by the rushing waters of the ford Jabbok: solitary Jacob kneeling in agonizing humble prayer on the pebble riverbank, hands outstretched to heaven while his family and livestock cross in misty torchlight behind him.

title: Wrestling the Angel at Peniel
image_prompt: Dynamic, high-contrast twilight struggle: Jacob fiercely grappling chest-to-chest with a luminous celestial stranger until the break of dawn, the divine figure touching Jacob's hip socket as golden morning sun bursts over the ridge of Penuel.

title: The Reconciliation of Jacob and Esau
image_prompt: Emotional desert meeting: Jacob, limping forward, bowing low to the ground seven times before red-bearded, armored warrior Esau, who runs forward in tears, throwing his arms around Jacob's neck in a passionate embrace of forgiveness.

title: The Altar El-elohe-Israel
image_prompt: Sunlit plain outside ancient Shechem: Jacob standing peacefully beside newly erected woven animal booths and white tents, pouring water and offering sacrifice on a rustic stone altar named El-elohe-Israel.

title: Dinah at the Gates of Shechem
image_prompt: Ancient arched stone gateway of Canaanite city Shechem: young Hebrew maiden Dinah in modest linen robe walking with local women carrying woven baskets, while young Prince Shechem in fine robes watches her from the city ramparts.

title: The Grief Over Simeon and Levi
image_prompt: Dusk outside the encampment: fierce brothers Simeon and Levi returning with bronze swords drawn under turbulent stormy skies, while grief-stricken patriarch Jacob confronts them with head in hands, decrying the violence.

title: Burying the Idols Under the Oak
image_prompt: Solemn ritual at the great terebinth oak of Shechem: Jacob and his family digging deep into the earth to bury silver foreign trinkets, amulets, and household figurines before dressing in pure clean white travel garments.

title: God Renames Israel at Bethel
image_prompt: Return to sacred Bethel: Jacob kneeling beside an anointed stone pillar bathed in brilliant supernatural golden light from an open heaven, receiving the renewed divine promise of nations and kings.

title: The Death of Rachel and Birth of Benjamin
image_prompt: Roadside tent near Ephrath (Bethlehem): weeping Jacob gently kissing the hand of dying Rachel as an elderly midwife wraps newborn infant Benjamin in warm swaddling linen; background showing the stone pillar Jacob erects on her solitary roadside tomb.

title: The Burial of Isaac at Mamre
image_prompt: Quiet sacred burial at the Cave of Machpelah: mature gray-haired brothers Jacob and Esau standing shoulder to shoulder in mutual grief, carrying the shroud-wrapped remains of 180-year-old father Isaac into the family rock tomb.

title: The Kingdom of Edom in Mount Seir
image_prompt: Sweeping vista of the rugged red sandstone canyons and towering carved cliffs of Mount Seir: chieftains of Esau in leather armor and bronze helmets commanding sprawling desert fortresses and camel caravans across the red desert.

title: The Coat of Many Colors
image_prompt: Pastoral Canaan encampment: aged Jacob tenderly draping a splendid, ankle-length woven tunic with vibrant multi-colored embroidery and ornate sleeves over handsome 17-year-old Joseph, while older brothers scowl in bitter jealousy from behind.

title: Joseph's Prophetic Dreams
image_prompt: Nighttime narrative composition: young Joseph standing by the campfire eagerly recounting his dreams, with ghostly luminous visions appearing in the night sky above: eleven sheaves of golden grain bowing to his tall central sheaf, and the sun, moon, and eleven stars bowing in orbit.

title: Cast into the Cistern at Dothan
image_prompt: Harsh sunlit plain of Dothan: furious brothers roughly stripping the ornate multi-colored coat from desperate Joseph, lowering him down with ropes into a dark, dry limestone cistern pit carved into the earth.

title: Sold to the Midianite Caravan
image_prompt: High-tension desert exchange: Judah counting twenty gleaming silver coins from the palm of a turbaned Midianite merchant, as Joseph is hauled out of the pit in coarse ropes and tethered to a desert camel caravan laden with spices bound for Egypt.

title: Jacob Mourns for Joseph
image_prompt: Inside a shadowed Canaanite tent: grief-stricken patriarch Jacob kneeling on the earthen floor in deep sorrow, clutching Joseph's torn, distinctive multi-colored woven tunic to his chest, clad in humble rough sackcloth with head bowed in mournful weeping.

title: Tamar at the Crossroads of Enaim
image_prompt: Arid roadside crossroads of Enaim near olive groves: Tamar, veiled modestly in dark travel shawls, receiving a carved stone signet ring, woven cord, and polished wooden shepherd staff from Judah as a pledge of payment.

title: The Tokens of Righteousness
image_prompt: Courtyard confrontation: dignified Tamar presenting the signet, cord, and staff to an astonished Judah, who looks down at his own family tokens with bowed head and humble realization of her righteousness.

title: Joseph Overseer in Potiphar's House
image_prompt: Grand, sunlit Egyptian villa with painted lotus columns and turquoise reflecting pools: Joseph, dressed in clean Egyptian white linen kilt and gold-bordered sash, directing scribes and servants managing grain stores with noble competence.

title: Joseph Flees from Temptation
image_prompt: Dynamic interior action scene: Joseph dashing out of an opulent painted Egyptian chamber into a sunlit colonnade, leaving his outer linen mantle gripped tightly in the clutching hands of Potiphar's wife seated on an ornate daybed.

title: Joseph Cast into the Royal Prison
image_prompt: Massive stone fortress prison of the Pharaoh: bronze-armored Egyptian guards chaining Joseph's wrists as angry Potiphar watches, while God's comforting divine presence illuminates Joseph as the prison keeper observes his calm integrity.

title: The Butler and the Baker in Prison
image_prompt: Dimly lit stone dungeon chamber: Joseph holding an oil lamp, approaching two troubled royal Egyptian prisoners—the Chief Butler and Chief Baker—who sit morosely on straw mats with troubled faces over mysterious night dreams.

title: The Chief Butler's Dream
image_prompt: Dreamlike visual panel: a lush grapevine with three flourishing green branches rapidly budding blossoms and heavy purple grape clusters, which are pressed directly into Pharaoh's ornate golden wine cup by a servant's hands.

title: The Chief Baker's Dream
image_prompt: Foreboding dream panel: a royal servant balancing three white woven wicker baskets stacked high upon his head, filled with royal baked pastries, while wild desert birds dive down aggressively to peck and snatch bread from the top basket.

title: Pharaoh's Birthday Feast
image_prompt: Opulent golden banquet hall of Pharaoh: the Pharaoh seated on a gilded lion throne receiving wine from the restored Chief Butler, while distant dark prison bars remind of forgotten Joseph waiting patiently in the fortress cellar.
